title: TradingAgents run manifest v1
description: One run_manifest.json per execution attempt (FR-C/NFR-C). Mirrors tradingagents.enhancements.manifest.validate_manifest. Report paths are relative to the results root; results-root containment and on-disk existence are checked at runtime, not by this schema.

run_id.description: Fresh UUID per execution attempt; same-day reruns each get their own.

finished_at.description: UTC-aware finish; null while a run is still running.

code_version.description: Installed package version when available; null when unknown.

models.description: Per-tier provider/model only; null when unknown. Extra keys (endpoints, keys) are not allowed.

configured_data_vendors.description: Configured source vendors (not per-request provenance); keys/tools filtered to known routing, values may be a fallback chain like sec_edgar,yfinance.

reports.description: Report paths relative to the results root; both keys are optional (omitted means not saved) and each value may be null.

complete_report_md.description: Path relative to the results root, or null when no report was saved.

complete_report_html.description: Path relative to the results root, or null when not generated.

error.description: Fixed error code plus safe text; null on success.
